input.answer: From what I made out, if I put in 750 ₪ a month, the employer adds 2,250 ₪, and after 5 years I'd be left with "136,457 ₪". But there's a red "‎-64,761 ₪" for tax because it's before 6 years, and the fund follows something called "S&P500", which is shares, so I won't decide anything until I've asked you or the bank.

stuck.why: The numbers sit above the bars, so I had to look back and forth to match them. I put in 45,000 and the employer added 135,000, yet what's left is only 136,457. The red striped part with "‎-64,761 ₪" scared me, and I couldn't tell whether I lose my own money.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the small striped bars for years 1–12
stuck.why: Yellow, grey, green and striped pink all look alike to me. I didn't try to read it, I only saw "לפני 6 שנים: מס" in pink.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the line under the chart about the fund
stuck.why: "מסלול 'מיטב השתלמות' עוקב מדד S&P500": I don't know what that is. To me מדד is the price index on the news.
The black background is tiring, and "מסלול השקעה" plus "רווחי הון" right at the start made me think this is investments, not a safe deposit.
